capabilities: Publish notes as short links to an Aliyun OSS or Tencent COS bucket
Export a note as a self-contained ZIP with HTML, CSS and images
Bundle directly linked notes (one level deeper) with navigation between pages
Track page views cookielessly via a self-hosted GoatCounter instance
Render note content for the web, including KaTeX, callouts, Dataview queries and Bases
disambiguation: Despite the name, it is not a link-graph or backlink tool; it publishes notes to the web and tracks views of the published pages.
extras: Requires a bucket with public read access and a custom domain so links open directly in the browser. Desktop only (no mobile support); requires Obsidian 1.7.2 or later. Interface available in English and Chinese. Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Sharing a note as a public web page normally requires a hosted publishing service or a server, and Obsidian offers no built-in way to publish with view analytics.

relations.evidence: One-click publish to your own Aliyun OSS or Tencent COS bucket
Publish route — choose one cloud storage backend and fill in its credentials: Aliyun OSS | Tencent COS
cookieless view tracking via a self-hosted GoatCounter instance, no personal data collected
Dataview queries rendered as static tables/lists
Image galleries with lightbox (including the Image Cluster imgs block format)

requires.name: Aliyun OSS or Tencent COS bucket

summary: Publishes notes as short web links on your own Aliyun OSS or Tencent COS bucket with view tracking, or exports them as self-contained ZIP files.
